Yeasts reproduce by a process called budding.

Yeasts reproduce by budding, in which new cells form from the parent cell through outpouching of the cell membrane and wall, migration of cytoplasm into the new structure, and eventual separation of the new cells from the parent cell.

Candida albicans is a type of yeast that can form biofilms on surfaces, and these biofilms can aid in the persistence and transmission of yeasts.
